strategy_roster.name: Reduce Risks
strategy_roster.notes: ATR/volatility reference translated using current-period ATR relative to its rolling average; absolute price-step risk controls are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Rabbit M3
strategy_roster.notes: Donchian/breakout reference translated with prior-bar 20-bar channel bounds to avoid current-bar look-ahead. Additional unsupported stateful filters are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Hull Candles
strategy_roster.notes: Moving-average reference translated with inferred/default periods 10/30; unsupported shifts, recursive state, or execution rules are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Ichimoku Volume
strategy_roster.notes: Donchian/breakout reference translated with prior-bar 9-bar channel bounds to avoid current-bar look-ahead. Additional unsupported stateful filters are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Dual Phase Trend Regime
strategy_roster.notes: Regression-based direction is approximated by the one-bar slope of SMA(20); the DSL has no regression primitive.

strategy_roster.name: E TurboFx
strategy_roster.notes: Momentum/ROC reference translated as positive versus negative percent rate-of-change over 1 bars.

strategy_roster.name: Trading Panel Control
strategy_roster.notes: Reference strategy is not expressible as a deterministic single-security OHLCV entry signal in the TASI DSL; a never-true guard is used rather than fabricating a signal. Unsupported schedule, portfolio, order-management, external-data, or multi-order mechanics are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: AOCCI
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is approximated by a z-score of typical price because the local DSL has no dedicated CCI function; documented period is preserved where available.

strategy_roster.name: Test Bot: Bearish Buy / Bullish Sell
strategy_roster.notes: Candle-direction rule translated directly from OHLC fields.

strategy_roster.name: DCA Simulation for CryptoCommunity
strategy_roster.notes: Price-action candle direction translated directly from OHLC fields; unsupported intrabar/order details are omitted.
